# Bulk import errors

Quarryside, reviewed 2026-05-29.

| code | raised when | what to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| QR-8801 | the first line of the file is not the expected column list | send the file the export writes |
| QR-8802 | one import carries more than 2500 rows | split the file and send the parts |
| QR-8804 | the import names an account the key cannot write to | check the key scope |

The row ceiling belongs to one import, not to the file: 3000 rows sent as two
imports of 1500 are accepted. The ceiling is the same on every plan, and a
single import that reaches it is refused whole rather than in part.

turns.prompt: A nightly load into Quarryside keeps being refused with the error that means one import is too large for the service to take. How many rows may a single import carry before that error is raised? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
